# Windows Cursor Simulation

> A free browser-based reference and live tester for all 36 predefined CSS `cursor` keywords. It shows the pointer that each visitor's own operating system and browser actually render.

Canonical URL: https://realsilasyang.github.io/windows-cursor-simulation/
Source repository: https://github.com/realSilasYang/windows-cursor-simulation
Technical specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/css-ui-4/#cursor

## Core facts

- The tool covers all 36 predefined `cursor` keywords in CSS Basic User Interface Module Level 4.
- Thirteen keywords map to standard Windows cursor-scheme roles.
- Twenty-three keywords have no dedicated standard Windows cursor-scheme slot and are rendered according to the browser and operating system.
- The page does not load, embed, or simulate `.cur` or `.ani` cursor files.
- `grab` and `grabbing` are CSS cursor states, not standard configurable Windows cursor-scheme roles.
- Search, use-case filters, and every cursor card are localized.
